description.value: Schoolhouse Farm is a small, woman-owned, family-run diversified farm in Ladner operating with no-spray, no-till, regenerative practices. Its farm store carries seasonally harvested vegetables, culinary and medicinal herbs, and cut flowers, plus a curated selection of third-party goods, accepting cash, card, and e-transfer. When fields are blooming, the farm also offers u-pick flower sessions in a working farm setting framed by willow trees and public seating.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active farm store at 6395 60 Avenue, Ladner (within the City of Delta), selling seasonal vegetables, herbs, and flowers using no-spray regenerative practices. No bike-specific infrastructure (racks, covered parking) is mentioned anywhere on the site; parking guidance refers to grass and gravel areas for vehicles. OSM opening hours (Wednesday/Saturday, June–October only) are inconsistent with the website's current Saturday/Sunday/Monday year-round schedule, indicating the OSM hours are outdated.
concerns: OSM addr:city is 'Delta'; website consistently uses 'Ladner, BC V4K 4E2'. Ladner is a community within the City of Delta — address is correct but city field may confuse mapping tools.
OSM opening_hours (Jun-Oct: Wed 13:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–16:00) conflict with the website's current schedule (Sat/Sun/Mon year-round, plus different busy-season hours). OSM hours appear outdated.
Website lists a second phone number for Admin + Events: (604) 240 7676, not present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, public-facing farm store selling fresh local produce and herbs — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Ladner road network. Listing is appropriate under Groceries.

Basic groceries.detail: Farm store stocks seasonal open-pollinated vegetables, culinary and medicinal herbs, and fruits harvested on-site, plus a small number of curated third-party food items

wow_evidence: small, woman-owned, family-run diversified farm … no-spray, no-till, regenerative practices
